limitations: A 13F is a delayed quarter-end snapshot; this report was filed 45 days after 2026-06-30.
It reports specified long reportable securities and does not provide a complete view of shorts, futures, most non-U.S. instruments, or direct XRP-token custody.
ETF shares are not equivalent to XRP held by the reporting manager.
The included-manager attribution is not proof of beneficial ownership or proprietary investment.
This observation is not a primary-market ETF creation/redemption flow.
actual_capital_classification: Reported ETF-share securities exposure; not verified XRP-token capital deployment.
admission_reason: A single delayed 13F filing is an institutional ownership/manager-attribution observation, not a synchronized spot-flow feature. Preserve as point-in-time research context only.
